svg.title: Transactions redesign, concept B: Insight feed
svg.desc: Overview-first feed for the Transactions page: filter chips with removable active filters, a range overview card with daily net bars, day cards with the day net, account-coloured avatars, and a collapsed account line when one account is selected. Desktop, mobile, account picker sheet, and loading, empty, error and end-of-range states.
svg.text: FINANCE MANAGER / TRANSACTIONS REDESIGN · ISSUE #993 · CONCEPT B
Concept B: Insight feed
Overview first, mobile first. Keeps today’s day cards; colour identifies the account, not the sign.

svg.text: Notes · dark theme and legend

g.text: Account colours come from a fixed eight-colour list indexed by a stable hash of AccountId (light: 600 shade,
dark: 300 shade); avatar fill is the colour at 14 % (light) / 22 % (dark). Red and green are excluded so the
amount keeps sole ownership of sign colour. Active chip: primary outline + 16 % primary tint.
